title: Ibrahim bin al-Mahdi and the Merchant's Sister
logline: A prince out for a stroll follows his nose to a stranger's door and his heart to a hand at the window, bluffs his way in to dinner, wins the house over with a lute, and leaves with a bride: and the proof is standing in the caliph's court.
moral: Honesty and open-handed generosity turn a gatecrasher into family, and are rewarded by the highest in the land.
tone: Warm romantic comedy of manners: light, sly and good-natured. The humour is in Ibrahim's too-casual face and the double mistake at the door; the feeling is in the music and the hand.

beats.summary: Frame: Ibrahim tells the caliph al-Ma'mun a story about himself; his young son stands by unremarked.
On a stroll he stops at a big house, caught by the smell of food.
A woman's hand at the window: the food is forgotten.
The tailor: the merchant who owns the house receives no strangers.
He follows two guests; each side takes him for the other's friend and he is welcomed.
After the feast a singer plays the lute and sings of longing.
He says something is missing; she is angry and the guests are shocked.
He plays and sings himself; she apologises; everyone praises him.
Alone with the host he admits he is of the caliph's family.
He confesses the second reason he came: the hand. The merchant will help.
The women of the house come one by one; none has the hand.
The sister appears and he knows her hand.
Marriage on the spot, a generous dowry, and gifts that overflow his house.
Back at court: the boy standing there is their son.
The caliph honours the merchant's generosity and brings him near.

props.description: Planned oud (lute), reused by name: pear body 110 x 150, round sound hole with a red rosette, short bent-back neck 120 long with 4 pegs, 4 string lines. Fields: rot, strum 0..1 (strings shiver 2 px), glow. Held across the body through person hold:'oud'.

The hand that starts the story. Skin-colour hand, 5 tapered fingers, 90 wide x 130 tall at s 1, red nail dots, a gold bangle (yellow band 14 thick with 3 red dots) at the wrist, a red ring on the third finger, and 40 px of blue dotted sleeve. Fields: s, rot, curl 0..1 (fingers close on a shutter or curtain edge), wave, glint 0..1 (star on the bangle), plain:true (no bangle or ring, wider palm: the other women's hands), bead:true (blue bead bracelet).
Planned brass tray (reused by name) 150 wide: roast bird dome, rice mound, bread, dates; fill 1..0 empties it; steam curls while fill > 0.5.
Planned loose floor cushion (reused by name) 100 x 30 in red, blue or yellow with dots.
Planned scroll (reused by name): open 0..1 unrolls to 200 x 120 with wavy lines and a red seal that stamps on (seal 0..1). The marriage contract.
Planned fat coin purse (reused by name), 60 x 70, red with a yellow tie; three stack into the dowry.

The chest of the planned treasureHoard module (reused): 120 x 90 box, domed lid, yellow bands; variants by seed: closed chest, open chest with coinPile, rolled carpet (cylinder 200 x 50, red and blue stripes), cloth bolt stack, foodTray. Stacked on a grid to fill the room.

scenes.composition: The window (MERCHANT.window, upper centre) is the clock: u 0.45 at 84.4 to 0.78 by 88.5 (sun down, moon and stars in). Leavers exit by the door at the left; the singer by the curtain at the right. Remaining pair: merchant x 400, Ibrahim x 540.

actions.action: under the LATER card: the window sky runs from dusk to night, lamps grow warmer; a row of small spent notes lies on the floor
actions.acting: everyone a little slumped and content

actions.action: still playing softly; a slow sparse note or two
actions.acting: lid 0.6, easy smile

scenes.summary: The merchant asks his real name; Ibrahim admits he is of the caliph's family, then confesses the two reasons he came: the smell, and the hand. The merchant offers to help.

actions.acting: gaze lookAt(merchant), level and honest, brow 0

scenes.summary: The sister appears; he knows the hand at once. The merchant offers her in marriage on the spot and fetches witnesses.

scenes.summary: The marriage is made with a generous dowry.

scenes.summary: The merchant sends his sister to Ibrahim's house with so many gifts that the room runs out of space.

scenes.summary: Back in the court the tale closes: the boy standing there is their son. The caliph, charmed by the merchant's generosity, brings him near. THE END.

THE END pops at 170.5 in the upper wall. Blinks and lamp flicker keep it alive to 173.5.

subtitles.ar: حكى إبراهيم بن المهدي للمأمون|أنه خرج يتنزه،|فتوقف أمام بيت كبير|بعدما شمّ رائحة طعام شهي.
subtitles.en: Ibrahim bin al-Mahdi told al-Ma'mun|that he had gone out for a stroll|and stopped in front of a large house|after smelling delicious food.

subtitles.ar: لمح خلف نافذة يد امرأة،|فنسي الطعام.|سأل خياطًا فعرف|أن البيت لتاجر لا يستقبل الغرباء.
subtitles.en: He glimpsed a woman's hand behind a window|and forgot about the food.|He asked a tailor and learned|that the house belonged to a merchant who did not receive strangers.

subtitles.ar: تبع رجلين يعرفان التاجر.|ظن الرجلان أنه صديق التاجر،|وظن التاجر أنه صديقهما،|فرحّبوا به.
subtitles.en: He followed two men who knew the merchant.|Each man thought he was the merchant's friend,|while the merchant thought he was their friend,|so they all welcomed him.

subtitles.ar: جلس إبراهيم إلى مائدة غنية بالأطعمة، ثم انتقل الحاضرون إلى قاعة للغناء.|دخلت جارية تعزف العود وأنشدت أبياتًا عن الشوق.|أعجب إبراهيم بصوتها، لكنه قال إن في أدائها شيئًا ناقصًا،|فغضبت منه أمام الضيوف.
subtitles.en: After a lavish meal,|an enslaved singer performed with a lute.|Ibrahim admired her music but said something was missing from the performance,|offending her and embarrassing the guests.

subtitles.ar: ندم إبراهيم على كلمته، وطلب عودًا ليبين قصده.|عزف وغنى أبياتًا رائعة،|فتغير موقف الجارية واعتذرت منه، وأشاد الحاضرون بموهبته.|استمر المجلس حتى غادر بقية الضيوف، وبقي إبراهيم مع صاحب البيت.
subtitles.en: Regretting his remark, Ibrahim took a lute|and performed beautifully.|The singer apologized, the guests praised his skill,|and eventually he was left alone with the host.

subtitles.ar: سأل التاجر ضيفه عن اسمه الحقيقي،|فاعترف إبراهيم بأنه من أسرة الخلافة.|دهش الرجل وسأله عن سبب مجيئه. ذكر إبراهيم رائحة الطعام،|ثم حكى عن اليد التي لمحها وراء النافذة، فأبدى التاجر استعدادًا لمساعدته.
subtitles.en: The merchant pressed for his guest’s identity|and learned he belonged to the caliphal family.|Ibrahim admitted that both the food|and the hand behind the window had drawn him in.

subtitles.ar: دعا التاجر نساء بيته واحدة بعد أخرى، لكن إبراهيم لم يجد صاحبة اليد بينهن.|قال التاجر إن أمه وأخته فقط لم تحضرا بعد.|وعندما ظهرت أخته عرف إبراهيم يدها،|فعرض التاجر زواجها منه وأحضر الشهود.
subtitles.en: The merchant called the women of his household in turn.|When his sister finally appeared,|Ibrahim recognized her hand.|The merchant immediately offered her in marriage and brought witnesses.

subtitles.ar: تم الزواج بمهر سخي،|وأرسل التاجر أخته إلى بيت إبراهيم مع هدايا كثيرة حتى ضاق بها المكان.|وختم إبراهيم حكايته أمام المأمون موضحًا أن له من زوجته ابنًا حاضرًا في المجلس.|أعجب الخليفة بكرم التاجر وقرّبه إليه.
subtitles.en: They married with a generous settlement|and lavish gifts.|Ibrahim told al-Ma’mun that their son now stood before him.|The caliph admired the merchant and brought him into his service.

new_assets.name: ladyHand
new_assets.description: A large, characterful woman's hand with a gold bangle and red ring (and plain / bead variants for other hands). The object the whole story turns on: seen at the window (15.74), in thought clouds and balloons, in the pinned memory inset, on the curtain edge (134.28) and on the sister's wrist. 90 x 130 at s 1, 40 px of blue dotted sleeve.
new_assets.implementation: One function ladyHand(ctx, x, y, {s, rot, curl, wave, glint, plain, bead, sleeve}). Palm = rounded rect in C.skin with the red Ben-Day dot shading of the person face; 4 fingers = tapered capsules whose tip angle is driven by curl (0 straight, 1 hooked 80 degrees over an edge), thumb a fifth capsule; nails = small red ellipses; bangle = yellow band 14 thick with black outline and 3 red dots; ring = red dot with black outline; glint = the star() helper scaled by glint. For the sister, draw the bangle alone at the person's P.hands position (bangle about 16 wide at s 1). Clip to the window or curtain opening when it comes from behind something.

new_assets.name: oud
new_assets.description: Planned oud (lute), reused by name (AN-087, AN-089, AN-103). Pear body 110 x 150, rosette, bent neck 120 long with 4 pegs. Used by the singer and by Ibrahim; passes from hand to hand at 70.98 and 80.4.
new_assets.implementation: oud(ctx, x, y, {s, rot, strum, glow}): body = ellipse in brown with a yellow face and dot shading, sound hole = black circle with a red ring, neck = thin rect ending in a 40 degree bent peg box, 4 strings as lines that offset by sin(t*60)*2*strum. If another story has already added it to Library/, use that one.

new_assets.name: person hold:'oud' (playOud)
new_assets.description: Playing pose for any person, standing or seated: the oud lies diagonally across the torso (neck up toward the figure's left), the right hand strums over the sound hole, the left hand moves along the neck.
new_assets.implementation: Opt-in fields hold:'oud', strum (phase), fret 0..1 in Library/cast/people.js. The oud is drawn after the torso and before the arms at local (0, -110), rot -0.5; handR = sound hole + [0, 10*sin(strum)], handL = a point along the neck at fret, both through the existing arm IK. Nothing changes when hold is absent, so the regression test stays identical. Prototype in the scene first if the layer order can be had there (draw the person with arms hidden behind the instrument is not acceptable); otherwise add the opt-in field.

new_assets.name: musicNotes
new_assets.description: Planned effect, reused by name: quaver glyphs released from a point that rise on seeded S-paths, rock and fade. Extra options used here: heart:true (the head becomes a small heart), big/gold (larger, yellow heads with a glint), frozen (hold positions), fall (drop with gravity and bounce), and a row mode (4 notes on a staff line with one slot empty or filled).
new_assets.implementation: musicNotes(ctx, x, y, t, {n, seed, col, head, heart, size, freezeAt, fallAt}); each note i is born at t0 + i*0.35 from K.rng(seed), position = origin + [sin path, -speed*age]; fallAt switches to fallY + rebound to the floor y 900. The row is drawn by the scene: a 260 px staff line with 4 note glyphs, slot 3 either dashed outline or gold.

new_assets.name: stinkLines (aroma mode)
new_assets.description: The planned smell lines (AN-090) in a pleasant mode: three wavy yellow ribbons with small steam curls and no flies, which can follow a bezier from a source to a nose and can go limp and drop.
new_assets.implementation: stinkLines(ctx, path, t, {mode:'aroma', n:3, reach 0..1, limp 0..1}): each ribbon a polyline along the bezier with a travelling sine offset (amplitude 14, phase t*3 + i), stroke yellow 8 px with black outline 12 px behind; reach clips the length; limp lerps every point down to the ground line.

new_assets.name: taleZoom
new_assets.description: Planned technique (AN-092), reused: enter a told story by letting the teller's thought cloud grow until its inside fills the panel (5.58-6.0), and leave it the same way in reverse (156.0-156.9).
new_assets.implementation: thoughtCloud(ctx, x, y, w, h, t, {inside, scale, at}) with w, h and scale keyed from (420, 280, 0.34) to (2600, 3200, 1.0) with an ease-in; the inside callback is the next scene's own drawWorld, so the first frame of S2 equals the last frame of the zoom. Draw the court underneath with alpha falling to 0.

new_assets.name: inset circle
new_assets.description: Planned round picture-in-picture with an iris and black brush border, reused by name: the pinned memory of the hand (radius 105) and the compare circle in S10 and S11; the throne inset at 99.56; the bride inset at 161.84.
new_assets.implementation: insetCircle(ctx, x, y, r, p, draw): clip to a circle of radius r*easeOutBack(p), paper background, call draw(ctx), then a 10 px black ring with a slight brush taper and a yellow outer ring.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon, reused by name, in single and two-frame modes (tailor 22.42-24, the four-note row 59.34-64.4, the name card 94.92, why here 104.02, smell and hand 107.08-112, mother and sister 129.82-132, marriage 140.08, generosity 167.18).
new_assets.implementation: iconBalloon(ctx, x, y, w, h, p, {tail:[tx, ty], draw}): the style module's speech box with a tail to the speaker and the picture clipped inside; pop with easeOutBack on p.

new_assets.name: giftChest (treasureHoard chest), purse, scroll, foodTray, floorCushion
new_assets.description: Planned small props reused under their planned names; see props for sizes. giftChest takes a seed for five variants so the pile is varied but cheap.
new_assets.implementation: Flat shapes with the Halftone Pop outline (black 6 px), yellow bands, red or blue dot fills. The pile is a deterministic list: item i lands at cell (col = i % 5, row = floor(i / 5)) at time 152.6 + 0.3 * i^0.85 with landSquash; draw back rows first.

new_assets.name: flush (soft option)
new_assets.description: The planned anger flush (red dots climbing the face plus steam puffs) for the singer at 63.52, and a soft option (pink cheeks only, no steam) for the bride at 140.9.
new_assets.implementation: flush(ctx, headX, headY, r, p, {soft}): clip to the head circle, fill red Ben-Day dots from the chin up to p of the head height; steam = two small cloud puffs rising from the temples unless soft.

new_assets.name: person laugh
new_assets.description: Planned helper built from existing fields (mouth open, lid 0.8..1, tip back, shoulders shaking) so every film laughs the same way; used by the merchant, the couple and the caliph.
new_assets.implementation: laugh(P, t, t0, dur): returns {mouth:'open', lid: 0.85, tip: -0.08, y: P.y - 3*abs(sin((t - t0)*22))} blended in and out with settleTo.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English translation is an abridgement of the Arabic in P4 to P8 (for example P4 omits sitting at the table, the move to the music hall and the verses of longing; P6 omits the merchant's astonishment, his question and his offer to help; P7 omits the failed search and 'only his mother and sister'; P8 omits sending the sister to Ibrahim's house until the place was too full). Both are kept verbatim; default: the picture follows the Arabic narration.
Ibrahim wears no crown or royal dress (green robe, yellow turban) both in the tale and in the court frame, so his rank stays hidden until 96 s and he is always recognisable; default: yes.
The singer (jariya, 'enslaved singer' in the English) is shown simply as a proud professional musician in the Library maiden costume, with no imagery of servitude; default: yes.
The hand is made recognisable by an invented gold bangle with red dots and a red ring (not in the script), so a phone viewer can tell it from the other women's hands; default: keep.

The sister's face is shown once she steps out (Library lady preset, veil over the hair); the three other women are shown fully and offer a hand each; the mother is never shown, only an icon; default: as described.
The son is placed silently in the court from the first frame as a set-up for the ending, and at the end he takes his uncle the merchant's hand (both additions beyond the script); default: keep.

The tale is staged inside Ibrahim's thought cloud (zoom in at 5.6 s, zoom out at 156 s) and at the end the merchant himself walks into the court and is seated beside the throne, as a literal picture of 'brought him near'; default: keep.

Invented comic lettering: SNIFF! SNIFF!, NO STRANGERS!, WELCOME!, FEAST, GASP!, BRAVO!, THE HAND, THE SISTER, THAT HAND!, MARRIED!, GIFTS, HIS SON!, plus name labels IBRAHIM, AL-MA'MUN, THE TAILOR, BIG HOUSE; default: keep all (cut FEAST and GIFTS first if it feels busy).
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; set LIFE.t = t each frame so every person blinks on its own seed; give every figure an explicit gaze (lookAt) in every scene.

The person figure is front-facing only: 'turning to' someone is done with gaze, a 3-6 px head offset, tip, and by which arm gestures. Poses that must read at phone size use arm angles aL/aR (crossed forearms 23.24, thumb back 19.04, arm to the boy 162.56), not hand targets near the head.

Three interior sets are one function, palaceHall variant 'merchant', with different wall colour and options; bake each option set once. The curtain is live (curtain 0..1) and must be drawn in front of people who are behind it: draw the entering figure, then call the set's curtain piece again (or clip the figure at MERCHANT.curtain.x) so nobody is seen through it.

The street is marketStreet with the palace facade as the merchant's house; take door and balcony positions from the returned anchors (M.palace.door, M.palace.balcony) rather than the approximate numbers in this plan. The balcony shutter is a scene-drawn townWindow over the balcony opening.

taleZoom: S2's drawWorld is the inside callback of the S1 cloud, and S13's drawWorld is the inside callback of the S14 cloud, so both cuts are continuous. Hide any camera jump at the moment the cloud edge passes the panel border.
The ladyHand must be pixel-consistent everywhere (same function, same bangle); the match at 137.72 is two inset circles drawing the same function with the same parameters, sliding together.

Music is visual only. Do not synthesise lute phrases under the narration: the word list shows almost no gaps (word ends run into the next word). Allowed effect slots from the timeline: 5.58-6.48, 12.68-13.74, 18.68-19.04, 25.44-26.44, 29.60-30.00, 127.28-128.00, 133.40-134.28 and after 170.32. A soft two-note pluck may be tried at 133.8 instead of the chime.
Groups never move in unison: use stagger(i) with 2-4 frame offsets for the guests (S5-S8), the three women (S10) and the two witnesses (S11-S12), and give each a different gesture.
Balloons and clouds are placed in the upper wall or sky (y 250..550) on the side away from the speaker's face; check every lettering item against head positions with a contact sheet.
S13 gift pile: deterministic grid from a seeded list; the push-in is a camera move, not a set change. Keep the couple's faces above y 760 so the caption panel never competes.

Subtitle chunks are given in 'subtitles' (4 per paragraph); copy them into chunks_ar.txt / chunks_en.txt. Because the English is abridged, English chunks in P4-P8 are paired with the nearest Arabic chunk in time, not sentence for sentence.
Durations: film length 173.5 s = 170.56 s audio + about 3 s of THE END (end_hold 3.0).
warnings: Long first Arabic chunks in P4 (13 words, 38.6-48.9 s) and P7 (14 words) and the second chunk of P8 (13 words): with only 4 chunks allowed per paragraph they are unavoidable; check that Noto Naskh 700 still fits the caption panel on three lines, and reduce size for those chunks only if needed.
English subtitles for P4-P8 are a summary of the Arabic, so the two captions will not say the same thing at every moment (owner question 1).

S9 is 25 s of two seated men: it depends on the balloons, the turban gag at 101.24 and gaze acting. If it feels static in stills, add a slow lamp-shadow drift and a tighter push-in on the confession rather than more lettering.

person hold:'oud' needs the instrument between the torso and the arms; if that layer order cannot be achieved from the scene file it requires an opt-in field in Library/cast/people.js (run the regression test: must stay 'all identical').
Many named figures (15 ids), all variants of one person function; keep at most 5 on screen at once (the plan never exceeds 5).

A woman's hand shown as the object of attraction and women presenting their hands: staged lightly and with dignity (the women are amused, the sister has her own reactions); flag for the owner's cultural review.
